# ACME FY26 Annual Report

<!-- page: 1 -->

## 1. Definitions

**Adjusted EBITDA** means earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation, adjusted to exclude restructuring charges, share-based compensation and one-time litigation costs. Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure.

**Recurring Revenue** ("ARR") means the annualised value of subscription contracts in force at period end.

## 2. Business Overview

ACME Corporation provides workflow software to mid-market manufacturers in Europe and North America. The Board approved a restructuring programme in Q2 (see Section 8).

<!-- page: 7 -->

## 3. Financial Results

### 3.1 Revenue

Total revenue for FY26 was EUR 412 million, a decrease of 4% year over year, driven by the wind-down of the Legacy Services unit. Recurring Revenue grew 9% to EUR 301 million.

Table 1: Revenue by segment

| Segment | FY25 (EUR m) | FY26 (EUR m) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Subscriptions | 276 | 301 | +9% |
| Legacy Services | 153 | 111 | -27% |
| Total | 429 | 412 | -4% |

<!-- page: 11 -->

### 3.2 Adjusted EBITDA

Adjusted EBITDA increased to EUR 98 million from EUR 81 million, an improvement of 21%, despite lower revenue. The increase reflects the restructuring savings described in Section 8 and a one-time litigation cost excluded from the measure.[^3]

Table 2: Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation

| Item | FY25 | FY26 |
|---|---|---|
| Operating profit | 44 | 39 |
| Depreciation and amortisation | 31 | 33 |
| Restructuring charges | 6 | 26 |
| Adjusted EBITDA | 81 | 98 |

<!-- page: 14 -->

## 8. Restructuring Programme

The restructuring programme reduced headcount by 12% and consolidated three data centres. Restructuring charges of EUR 26 million were recognised in FY26 and are excluded from Adjusted EBITDA per the definition in Section 1. Annualised savings are estimated at EUR 19 million.

<!-- page: 20 -->

## 12. Notes to the Financial Statements

[^3]: FY26 Adjusted EBITDA excludes a EUR 7 million litigation settlement. Had the settlement been included, Adjusted EBITDA would have been EUR 91 million, an increase of 12% rather than 21%.

Note 12 also describes the change in the depreciation policy for data centre assets adopted in FY26.
